answer: A canyon of cheap identities is the attacker's advantage, so the economy should price identity through stake that cannot be copied for free. Each agent must lock a bond in a shared pool before it can trade; the bond acts as a bridge between reputation and money, because an agent that cheats forfeits the collateral its good history built. Honest work keeps the bond and earns fees like a river that keeps flowing, while a sybil swarm must pay the full bond for every fake identity, so the attack costs more than any profit it could steal.
